// Runs Finglass's sync::redactor over a corpus and writes the results as JSON for the Go port.
use finglass_core::sync::redactor::{fints_escaped, mask_account_numbers, redact, return_codes};
use serde_json::json;

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap();
    let texts: Vec<&str> = vec![
        "",
        "Konto DE89370400440532013000 gesperrt",
        "IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 ungültig",
        "iban de89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 lower case",
        "Invalid check digits DE00 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 here",
        "AT611904300234573201 and GB82WEST12345698765432 and FR1420041010050500013M02606",
        "CH9300762011623852957, NL91ABNA0417164300.",
        "Müller überweist von DE89370400440532013000 an Ärzte",
        "ÄÖÜ äöü ß DE44500105175407324931 ende",
        "Kontonummer 1234567890 ist gesperrt",
        "Kontonr. 0532013000, BLZ 37040044",
        "Kto-Nr.: 12345 short",
        "Kto.-Nr. 123 4567 89 spaced",
        "Account no. 98765432 closed",
        "account number 1234 5678 9012",
        "acct 7654321",
        "Konto 12345678,90 EUR is an amount",
        "Betrag 1.234.567,89 EUR",
        "Ref 123456 and 1234567 and 12345 and ABC123456 and 123456X",
        "HIRMS:4:2:3+3010::Keine Umsätze vorhanden+9010::Auftrag abgelehnt+0020::OK",
        "3060 Bitte beachten Sie die Warnung; Kunde …3000 hat 9942 PIN falsch",
        "9931 Anmeldung gesperrt für Konto 5412345678901234",
        "Karte 5412 3456 7890 1234 gesperrt",
        "Mehrere: DE89370400440532013000; DE44500105175407324931; 1234567890",
        "Kein Konto hier, nur Text mit Zahlen 2026 und 3,78",
        "Tab\tDE89370400440532013000\nnewline Kontonummer\t1234567890",
        "Emoji 💶 DE89370400440532013000 💶",
        "Zero-width\u{200b}DE89370400440532013000",
        "Arabic digits ١٢٣٤٥٦٧ and full-width １２３４５６７",
        "Prefix…DE89370400440532013000 and 9999",
        "DE89370400440532013000DE44500105175407324931",
        "XX12ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP plausible shape",
        "de8937040044053201300 short lower",
        "PIN 12345 secret value correct horse",
    ];
    let secrets: Vec<Vec<&str>> = vec![
        vec![],
        vec!["12345"],
        vec!["correct horse", "horse"],
        vec!["a+b:c'd?e@f", "abc"],
        vec!["   ", "abc", "1234"],
    ];
    let mut cases = Vec::new();
    for text in &texts {
        let masked = mask_account_numbers(text);
        let mut redacted = Vec::new();
        for set in &secrets {
            redacted.push(json!({"secrets": set, "out": redact(text, set)}));
        }
        cases.push(json!({
            "text": text,
            "mask_account_numbers": masked,
            "return_codes_of_masked": return_codes(Some(&masked)),
            "return_codes_of_text": return_codes(Some(text)),
            "redact": redacted,
        }));
    }
    let escaped: Vec<_> = ["", "plain", "a+b:c'd?e@f", "??", "Ümlaut+"].iter()
        .map(|value| json!({"value": value, "out": fints_escaped(value)})).collect();
    let doc = json!({"cases": cases, "fints_escaped": escaped, "return_codes_none": return_codes(None)});
    std::fs::write(format!("{out}/redactor.json"), serde_json::to_string_pretty(&doc).unwrap() + "\n").unwrap();
}
